purpose: Named-terminal redraw of the earlier field guide, updated to installed C3 hardware. Not a physical pad layout.
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a precise editorial wiring diagram for a personal engineering blog, revised from a printed electronics field guide. White/light ivory background, dark charcoal text, fine clean line drawing, readable large humanist sans lettering, muted but distinct wire colours. Landscape 1600x1150 or similar. This is a NAMED-TERMINAL CONNECTION DIAGRAM, never a physical PCB footprint. Do NOT draw board pads or depict chip packages. Left is a restrained rectangle titled "Key Light board"; right is a rectangle titled "ESP32-C3". Five well separated horizontal connection rows between them, red, black, yellow ochre, green, blue in order. Labels must be exactly paired as follows, left label -> right label:
"J6 / DEBUG · 3.37 V" -> "3.3"
"J8 / UART · GND" -> "G"
"U4 · SDA" -> "GPIO4"
"U4 · SCL" -> "GPIO5"
"U4 · OE" -> "GPIO6"
Lines should connect corresponding row terminals with small dots, no arrows, no crossed lines. Signal names plus colour words "red", "black", "yellow", "green", "blue" near each line so not colour alone. Under these five rows in a distinct bottom annotation area, exact text:
"Corrected U4 top row"
"White power resistors to the left; U4 below the PCA9635."
"OE: 5th pad from the left, counting from 1."
"SDA: second from right.  SCL: rightmost."
Small footer "Connection diagram, not a soldering template." No other text. Keep generous whitespace and type legible at 700px blog width. Do not add an external supply, buck converter, transistor, antenna, 5V connection, resistor fix or invented signal. Diagram shows exactly five wires.
correction: Edit this wiring diagram. Preserve every connection, terminal name, colour, and the complete lower annotation area verbatim. Make only one content simplification: the duplicated long labels over the five wires must become just the colour words "red", "black", "yellow", "green", "blue" in corresponding rows. Do not use any dash punctuation in those labels. The left box already contains J6 / DEBUG · 3.37 V, J8 / UART · GND, U4 · SDA, U4 · SCL, U4 · OE; preserve them and all right-box targets (3.3, G, GPIO4, GPIO5, GPIO6). Exactly five wires. White background, clean editorial technical diagram.
headingRevision: Edit this wiring diagram with ONE exact text change only: the heading "Corrected U4 top row" must read "U4 top row". Preserve every other label, wire, colour, endpoint, annotation, spacing and diagram element. Do not add any content or alter connections.
review: Verified five wire colors and terminal targets, U4 orientation, OE fifth from left, SDA second from right, SCL rightmost. Heading describes the current map without correction history. Photographs use conventional edits from prepare-photos.py; generated photo edits were rejected.
